rapport_notes: Friendly greeting and tone, but mostly transactional; minimal warmth or personal connection built during the call.
process_discipline_notes: Amy asked the agenda question ('any majors concerns that you'd like me to address') but did not hold silence after — she immediately launched into the estimate pitch without waiting for a real response.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I'd like to ask you some questions to get us on the right track and then I'll create an estimate that you can depend on I'll send it to you via email so no need to take notes. This call will probably take five to ten hours to complete.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Let me know if you have any questions or maybe there's something you're most worried about. Any majors concerns that you'd like me to address or inform the movers.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No follow-up at all. Customer said 'No, I don't have anything' and Amy immediately pivoted: 'Alright, so let's get started then.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typically a two bedroom apartment, we would send two movers one truck. It would take anywhere from three and a half to five and a half hours to complete. Your inventory is very straightforward. But I would like to highlight the factor that we're coming out of a third floor apartment... I would suggest budgeting for three and a half maybe up to four and a half hours.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: The more prepared you are last time the move will take more money again the same. Does that sound fair?
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: So yeah that's it very straightforward. I'll email you the estimate so you can review again later or if you're ready to lock this date now Jarvis we don't require any deposits. Would you like us to help you with the move?

top_strength: Amy delivered a clear, itemized estimate with proper anchor framing (typical range 3.5–5.5 hours, personalized down to 3.5–4.5 based on third-floor access and drive time) and explicitly asked for the booking.
coaching_note: Amy asked the agenda question but never paused for the customer's answer — she needs to hold silence after open-ended questions and actually dig two layers deep into any concerns raised; she also missed all four differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, Communication) entirely, which should have landed either in Stage 1 (if customer raised them) or in Stage 2 as the takeaway.
